name: normnet
description: NormNet — auditable business-process automation with local LLMs

scripts.dev: npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend install --no-audit --no-fund --silent && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.start: npm run build && uv run uvicorn server.app:app --port 8000
